title: Jev as judge
summary: Judge two candidate answers against one explicit factual reference.
why: An evaluator can emit a winner without generating a critique.

winner.instructions: Which candidate correctly answers the question using only the reference?

state.question: What is the capital of France?
state.reference: Paris is the capital of France.

limitation: Toy judge, not an objective quality oracle. Use human labels, swap candidate order, and evaluate position bias and disagreement.
